children: Asos is on the right track for a sustained recovery in profits as its turnaround strategy starts to bear fruit, Berenberg analysts write. The online fashion retailer reported a significant improvement in profit in its trading update, which Berenberg says marks the first sign of a return to growth in four years. "The transformation strategy to date has involved deep business model change within Asos's own label, a switch from performance marketing to fashion relevance and investment in the customer experience with a new app," the analysts say. Berenberg hikes its price target on the stock to 750 pence from 600 pence and keeps its buy rating. Shares are 6.4% higher at 457.50 pence. (joseph.wilkins@wsj.com)
